verdict.rationale: Vue's own docs assert a 'truly reactive, compiler-optimized rendering system that rarely requires manual optimization,' directly matching the story, and community comments note Vue's reactivity ergonomics and performance versus alternatives. However the evidence pack lacks technical detail on the compiler's diffing/patch-flag mechanics or independent benchmarks confirming 'surgical' updates. Missing for 10: deeper first-party technical docs on compiler optimizations (patch flags, block tree), independent hands-on performance verification of update efficiency.
